terms.title: Ordering Terms
rules: Minimum purchase is **10 pcs** of pempek.
Small pempek (telur, keriting, lenjer kecil, adaan, kulit) must be ordered at least **5 pcs per type**.
Want to try all 5 small types? Order at least **25 pcs**.
Orders are processed right after the PO schedule closes.

largeOrder.title: Ordering more than 50 pcs?
largeOrder.note: Cuko bonus is calculated by order multiples.
largeOrder.example: Example: 60 pcs = 2 × 250 ml + 1 × 120 ml bottles; 75 pcs = 3 × 250 ml bottles.
